summary: Successfully tested Admin RFQ-Vendor Manual Matching feature. All 21 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI testing confirms RFQs tab with Match button, Match Vendors dialog with vendor search/filter/select, Already Matched badges, View Matches dialog with status display, and remove match functionality.

critical_code_review_comments: Manual matching feature is fully implemented with proper RBAC checks (requires admin access or rfqs.match_vendors permission)
Activity logging implemented for match/unmatch actions
Notifications sent to vendors (email, WhatsApp if configured, in-app) and buyer on match
Already matched vendors displayed with 'Already Matched' badge and excluded from selection
Both rfq_vendor_matches collection and matched_vendors array in RFQ updated for backward compatibility
data-testid attributes properly added for testing: match-vendors-{rfq_id}, view-matches-{rfq_id}, vendor-{vendor_id}, confirm-match-btn, remove-match-{vendor_id}

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin RFQ-Vendor Manual Matching feature is fully functional. RFQs Tab in Admin Dashboard has Match button (data-testid='match-vendors-{rfqId}') that opens Match Vendors dialog. View Matches via 'X vendors' link shows matched vendors with status and remove option. Backend APIs at /api/admin/rfq/{rfqId}/match-vendors (POST), /api/admin/rfq/{rfqId}/matches (GET), /api/admin/rfq/{rfqId}/match/{vendorId} (DELETE, PUT status). /api/admin/vendors/search returns vendors with machine info for matching.
